qualities.name: Broken
qualities.note: Unusable until repaired; sold for scrap or parts.

qualities.name: Poor
qualities.note: Shoddy or worn, works for now.

qualities.name: Normal
qualities.note: Ordinary workmanship. Base prices assume this.

qualities.name: Good
qualities.note: Well made by a skilled hand.

qualities.name: Great
qualities.note: Exceptional work from a known craftsman; harder to find.

qualities.name: Masterwork
qualities.note: A master’s piece; usually made to order.

qualities.name: Legendary
qualities.note: Spoken of in stories; never just sitting on a shelf.

qualities.name: Artifact
qualities.note: One of a kind. Finding a seller is an adventure in itself.

items.name: Mithral ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Feather-light yet stronger than steel; resists corrosion and magic. Elven armour.

items.name: Adamantine ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Nearly indestructible; cleaves ordinary metal. Needs a magical forge to melt.

items.name: Orichalcum ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Conducts magic superbly and glows when it is channelled. Enchanted weapons and staves.

items.name: Duskiron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Drinks light and weakens nearby spells; never rusts or dulls. Forged in shadow flame.

items.name: Celestium ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Holy meteor metal; smites evil. Armour resists necrotic and radiant. Divine fire only.

items.name: Bloodiron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Sharpens with every kill; armour slowly regenerates. Forging needs blood sacrifice.

items.name: Frostforged Iron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Never warms; freezes what it cuts and resists fire.

items.name: Soulsteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Forged from bound souls; drains life, armour whispers. Illegal in most kingdoms.

items.name: Voidsteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Swallows sound, light and magic; cuts slightly through dimensions.

items.name: Sunforged Gold ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Glows near evil; extra damage to undead and fiends. Forged only at high noon.

items.name: Glamourite ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Weapons confuse with illusions; armour resists charm. Reforms under moonlight.

items.name: Dracosteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Keeps the element of the dragon that forged it. Only dragonkin can work it properly.

items.name: Living Bronze ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Animate metal; regenerates on blood or magic and must be fed oil or mana.

items.name: Witchiron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Hex metal that stores spells; weapons inflict minor curses. Hated by paladins.

items.name: Stormforged Electrum ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Chains lightning between foes; immune to lightning. Forged in lightning strikes.

items.name: Ghoul's Lead ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Weapons rot flesh; armour grants disease immunity. Mined from plague fields and crypts.

items.name: Verdantite ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Eldergreen living metal shaped by druid magic; weapons sprout entangling vines.
needs: Druidic shaping of living metal or wood (per item)

items.name: Pyrestone ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Never fully solid; burns forever without fuel. Armour grants fire immunity.

items.name: Moonshadow Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Invisible in moonlight unless moving; stronger at night. Forged under eclipses.

items.name: Chimera's Hide ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Unstable fusion of metals; may resist magic or explode when struck.

items.name: Nightmare Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Oneiros iron; inflicts hallucinations. Armour blocks psychic attacks but brings night terrors.

items.name: Titanscale ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Shed by primordial titans; self-repairs in sunlight. Only giants can forge it.

items.name: Plaguesteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Blight ore; infects wounds with disease. Armour grants poison immunity. Toxic fumes.

items.name: Aetherium ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Skyglass metal; weightless, used for airship hulls. Shatters under silence.

items.name: Rimefang ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Frostbite iron; freezes flesh. Armour gives cold immunity but fire weakness.

items.name: Doombringer ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Apocalypse core; weapons grow heavier with each kill, armour shows your death.

items.name: Serpentine ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Ouroboros steel; repairs itself overnight. Armour becomes a second skin.

items.name: Hollow Ore ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Ghost iron; passes through armour to strike the soul.

items.name: Sunsparker ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Solarite; blinds on impact and armour reflects spells.

items.name: Wraithbone ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Necrosilver; carved, not melted. Light as paper and repairs on life force.

items.name: Thunderbolt Iron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Stormrend; chains lightning, and armour converts lightning to energy.

items.name: Ashenford ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Phoenix cinder; bursts into flame. Armour resurrects its wearer once.

items.name: Veilsteele ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Fogmetal; ignores ethereal resistance and fades from view in mist.

items.name: Dreadroot ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Terror alloy; strikes panic, and armour feeds on fear.

items.name: Starfall Adamant ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Cosmic ore from dead stars' craters; distorts gravity on impact.

items.name: Luminite ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Dawn crystal metal; purifies corruption. Sacred to paladins of the morning light.

items.name: Abyssal Brass ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Demonforged in hellfire; burning weapons, but armour corrupts the soul.

items.name: Golem's Heart ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Animate core awakened with a soul; guides strikes and repairs itself.

items.name: Souldrift ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Ethereum, half solid and half gas; harvested from the River Styx.

items.name: Wyrmgold ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Dragon's hoard alloy, 1 pp per kg. Sharpens near treasure; armour dazzles.

items.name: Aeltherion ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Astral silver; afterimage strikes and brief floating. Reshaped only in astral storms.

items.name: Gravemire Iron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Slows foes as if dragged; armour muffles sound and heartbeat.

items.name: Thalorite ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Forged underwater; armour lets the wearer breathe underwater.

items.name: Skydrake Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Extremely light; gusts on impact, armour allows gliding.

items.name: Oblivionite ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Erases fragments of matter; feared by archmages.

items.name: Sylphae Silver ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Faster strikes; armour feels weightless.

items.name: Krakensteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Grips like tentacles on impact; stronger when submerged.

items.name: Emberveil Iron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Ignites briefly after striking; armour smokes when damaged.

items.name: Faeweave Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Flickering illusions; armour subtly alters the wearer's appearance.

items.name: Gloomshard Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Lingering shadow wounds; armour blends with darkness.

items.name: Aurorium ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Radiant bursts; armour dazzles with shifting light. Forged under polar lights.

items.name: Rotfang Steel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Decays armour and shields; armour corrodes nearby weapons.

items.name: Dreamglass Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Vivid hallucinations; partial invisibility during sleep or meditation.

items.name: Runeforged Steel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Holds enchantments without decay; amplifies spellcasting.

items.name: Dreadfrost Ore ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Freezes wounds instantly; armour leaves frost footprints.

items.name: Mythrilite ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Lighter than mithral, harder than adamantine; never dulls.

items.name: Tombsteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Weakens the living; armour wards against necromancy.

items.name: Starwhisper Ore ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Meteor ore that hums near cosmic magic; armour resists psychic attacks.

items.name: Infernum Iron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Releases hellfire bursts; armour radiates heat.

items.name: Frostveil Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Cold mist trails; armour hides the wearer in frost fog.

items.name: Eldershard Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Grows stronger with age; armour stores centuries of battle memory.

items.name: Stormglass Steel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Discharges lightning arcs; armour turns lightning damage into speed.

items.name: Phantomite ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Phases through physical armour; brief intangibility.

items.name: Titanblood Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Strikes with immense force; armour greatly increases strength.

items.name: Moonflare Silver ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Extra damage under moonlight; armour reflects lunar magic.

items.name: Griffonsteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Diving momentum on strikes; armour enhances jumping.

items.name: Soulbloom Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Bursts of magical petals; armour slowly heals minor wounds.

items.name: Riftiron ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Tears small rifts in space; armour protects against dimensional magic.

items.name: Echosteel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Sonic shockwaves; armour completely dampens loud noise.

items.name: Wildroot Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Sprouts thorny vines; armour regenerates like living wood.
needs: Druidic shaping of living metal or wood (per item)

items.name: Bloodstar Ore ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Stronger as the wielder bleeds; armour repairs on spilled blood.

items.name: Thunderheart Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Thunderclaps on impact; armour enhances momentum.

items.name: Astryx Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Distorts gravity; armour lets the wearer walk on walls briefly.

items.name: Goldshade Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Drains energy from foes; armour hides the wearer in dim light.

items.name: Crystalforge Steel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Refracts spells; armour reflects light in blinding bursts.

items.name: Nethercore Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Weakens magical barriers; armour reduces spell damage.

items.name: Skyflare Alloy ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Faster strikes while airborne; armour grants short bursts of flight.

items.name: Shadowthorn Steel ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Bleeding shadow wounds; armour injures those who strike it.

items.name: Celestial Prism Metal ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Refracts radiant beams; armour raises radiant shields.

items.name: Eternium ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Never breaks or dulls; armour repairs itself forever. The ultimate artifact metal.

items.name: Ironroot plank
items.note: Hard as steel yet flexible; needs enchanted tools to shape. Fortress gates, warship hulls.

items.name: Moonwillow plank
items.note: Bends without breaking, ideal for bows and whips; staves enhance lunar magic.

items.name: Emberpine plank
items.note: Fire-proof and burns for years; weapons deal extra fire damage.

items.name: Whisperwood plank
items.note: Carries a whisper from one end to the other; spy networks.

items.name: Stormoak plank
items.note: Attracts lightning but never burns; shields deflect thunder spells.

items.name: Bloodthorn plank
items.note: Drinks blood to sharpen; its wounds heal slowly. Cursed.

items.name: Feybirch plank
items.note: Confuses those who touch it uninvited; illusionist wands and trickster tools.

items.name: Duskwood plank
items.note: Shadows cling to it; stealth gear and traceless arrows.

items.name: Sunbeam Ash plank
items.note: Glows when polished; undead recoil from its touch.

items.name: Wraithwood plank
items.note: Semi-corporeal; ghostly armour and bars that trap spirits.

items.name: Thornheart plank
items.note: Grows when watered with blood; living fences attack intruders.
needs: Druidic shaping of living metal or wood (per item)

items.name: Tidewood plank
items.note: Never rots in water; faster ships, harder strikes underwater.

items.name: Voidroot plank
items.note: Spells fizzle near it; used for anti-mage prisons.

items.name: Dreamwillow plank
items.note: Induces visions when burned; sleepwalkers are drawn to it.

items.name: Bonewood plank
items.note: Hard as steel, light as pine; necromancers carve control runes into it.

items.name: Frostpine plank
items.note: Never thaws; ice staves, and arrows freeze their targets.

items.name: Laughing Oak plank
items.note: Giggles when touched; weapons disorient foes with laughter.

items.name: Witchwood plank
items.note: Stores spells like a wand; curses those who misuse it.

items.name: Starfall Cedar plank
items.note: Fell from the sky in a meteor; enhances cosmic magic.

items.name: Silkwood plank
items.note: Light as silk, strong as steel; royal garments and assassin's tools.

items.name: Doomspruce plank
items.note: Its sap turns black before tragedy.

items.name: Phoenix Palm plank
items.note: Regenerates when burned; used in resurrection rituals.

items.name: Veinroot plank
items.note: Grows when fed blood; vampires use it for coffins.
needs: Druidic shaping of living metal or wood (per item)

items.name: Eldertree plank
items.note: Holds the forest's memories; druids commune with it for wisdom.
needs: Druidic shaping of living metal or wood (per item)

items.name: Chaos Elm plank
items.note: Unpredictable; may turn weapons into flowers or explode.

items.name: Assaying an unknown metal
items.note: Identify a strange ore or ingot and estimate its worth.

items.name: Exotic metal smithing (per item)
items.note: Surcharge for a smith able to work rare metals, on top of materials.

items.name: Druidic shaping of living metal or wood (per item)
items.note: For Verdantite, Wildroot and other materials that must be grown, not forged.

items.name: Rare-wood carving (per item)
items.note: A woodworker with enchanted tools, on top of materials.

items.name: Enchanted woodworking tools (week rental)
items.note: Needed to cut Ironroot and similar woods.

items.name: Dragonfire forging (per item)
items.note: Required for Dracosteel, Wyrmgold and Orichalcum.

items.name: Divine forge access (day)
items.note: Required for Celestium and Sunforged Gold.

items.name: Hellfire forging (per item)
items.note: Required for Abyssal Brass and Infernum Iron. Rarely asked about openly.

items.note: Heavy and soft; sling bullets, roofing and seals.

items.name: Pewter (1 kg)
items.note: Soft tin alloy for tableware and cheap trinkets.

items.name: Brass ingot (1 kg)
items.note: Bright copper-zinc alloy for fittings, buckles and instruments.

items.name: Blackiron ingot (1 kg)

items.name: Cold iron ingot (1 kg)

items.name: Dwarven steel ingot (1 kg)

items.name: Damascened steel ingot (1 kg)

items.name: Electrum ingot (1 kg)

items.name: Alchemical silver ingot (1 kg)

items.name: Meteoric iron ingot (1 kg)

items.name: Bamboo (bundle)

items.name: Cedar plank

items.name: Teak plank

items.name: Rosewood plank

items.name: Ebony plank
